events.description: A teal 2D circle is drawn and then smoothly transforms into 50 stacked latitude circles while the camera reorients to a 3D perspective.
events.clip_query: A 2D teal circle transforms into a 3D sphere made of stacked latitude circles as the camera rotates.

events.description: The latitude lines fade out as a solid blue sphere mesh fades in.
events.clip_query: A solid blue sphere mesh fades in, replacing the latitude lines.

events.description: The solid sphere mesh transforms into 20 nested latitude spheres representing 4D slices, which begin to rotate.
events.clip_query: A solid sphere splits into multiple nested, semi-transparent spheres that start rotating.

events.description: The nested 4D latitude spheres undergo a continuous, complex 4D rotation driven by the ValueTracker.
events.clip_query: A complex 4D rotation of nested semi-transparent spheres projecting dynamically into 3D space.
